title: Animal camouflage
examples: Why do some animals change their color?
What is camouflage used for in the wild?
Can animals really hide from people?

explain.say: Look at this picture. The animal is the same colour as the leaves.
Matching the background helps animals stay hidden.
Some animals have stripes. Stripes break up the shape of their body.
Spots can match the patches of light and shade under trees.
Chameleons can change their skin colour. They do it to show feelings and to warm up or cool down.
People use camouflage too. Wearing green in a green park makes you harder to see.

faq.q: Why do animals need to hide?
faq.a: They hide to stay safe from bigger animals or to sneak up on food.
asks: What is the purpose of camouflage?

faq.a: No, some animals use other ways to stay safe, like making loud noises.
asks: What if an animal cannot blend in?

faq.q: Can chameleons change color all the time?
faq.a: They change colour mostly to show feelings and to warm up or cool down.
asks: Is color change only for hiding?

faq.a: Sometimes stripes can also help animals look strong or warn others away.
asks: What else can stripes do for an animal?

faq.q: Is blending in the same as camouflage?
faq.a: Yes, blending in is one way that camouflage helps an animal stay hidden.
asks: What is the link between blending and camouflage?
Are these two words the same thing?

facts: Camouflage helps animals avoid being seen by predators.
Stripes and spots help break up the animal's outline.
Chameleons are famous for changing their skin color.
Animals use camouflage for both hiding and surprising others.

quiz.say: A green frog sits on a green leaf. Why is it hard to see?
quiz.why: The frog is the same colour as the leaf. That is camouflage.

wrong.1: Big animals are easier to see, so size gives no help here.
wrong.2: A noise would make the frog easier to find.

quiz.say: An animal lives on dry, dusty ground. Which coat helps it hide?
quiz.why: A brown, spotty coat matches the dusty ground.

wrong.0: Bright blue stands out on dusty ground.
wrong.2: Shiny red stands out on dusty ground.

quiz.say: Which animal can change the colour of its skin?
quiz.why: A chameleon can change its skin colour.

wrong.0: A tiger's stripes stay the same.
wrong.1: A zebra's stripes stay black and white.
